description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) related to notifications in a Kotlin frontend project, including JSON serialization metadata, and provides an extension function to convert DTOs into domain models with safe defaults.

classes.name: NotificationsDtos.NotificationDto
classes.description: Data class representing a notification object received from the backend, with JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: NotificationsDtos.MarkReadRequest
classes.description: Data class for request payload to mark a notification as read, identified by ID.

methods.name: toDomain
methods.description: Extension function converting a NotificationDto into a NotificationItem domain model, applying default values and mapping string types/deeplinks to enum values.
